ActorTalk: W-Why are you all staring at me? I didn't do anything wrong!
You're too nervous for that to be convincing.
Surveillance footage caught you loitering around the Kuroros, and then those Kuroros started malfunctioning. I'm sure you know what I'm getting at, right?
It wasn't me! I was just passing by when I saw some guy being all sneaky around the Kuroros! There's no way he was up to any good!
After he left, I got a bit curious, so I went over to look around... That's when those Kuroros suddenly started acting weird.
Then Mister Asimov showed up... I was worried he'd think I was the one causing trouble, so I bolted...
Your thought process sure is... unique.
Wait... I still remember what he said! He said he wanted to spread some code to all the Kuroros in the residential district!
You guys should hurry up and go catch that person!
